column1: # EXCLUDED.tsv -- snoflake_suite: the programs of this package that are NOT IN THE SPITBOL DIALECT, out of the published denominator, one row per program: name<TAB>NOT_SPITBOL_DIALECT<TAB>the feature, its dialect, the oracle's own refusal and CSNOBOL4's verdict.

# THE TEST (Lon 2026-09-26 15:0x CDT, in-chat to the ceo, verbatim: "So the way to tell if a program is SPITBOL dialect is two-fold, 1st is rejected by SPITBOL, and 2nd why it is rejected is a CSNOBOL4 feature not supported. Then if these two are true it is NOT SPITBOL dialect."; ceo CEO-1286).

# BOTH halves must hold: a program sbl -bf refuses for any OTHER cause (a SPITBOL-documented feature the x64 fork lacks, a Macro SPITBOL 370 convention, a missing input, a UTF-8 BOM, lowercase source waiting for its case conversion, a program broken under CSNOBOL4 too) STAYS in the denominator, named in OUTSIDE_SPITBOL_BASELINE.tsv beside this file as debt.

# SPITBOL's own test deck (spitbol_testpgms/test1..8.spt and the csnobol4_suite copies diag1/diag2) is SPITBOL dialect BY ORIGIN (Lon 2026-09-26: "Get ALL 8 working in SCRIP since they are SPITBOL programs.") whatever the x64 fork refuses.

# EXCLUDED=48 of the shipped population; the suite row reads pass / (shipped - EXCLUDED) with EXCLUDED named. Measured 2026-09-26 against sbl -bf (the ONE oracle) and csnobol4 -b (the reference engine, never a grader); the probes are recorded in GOAL-CEO.md CEO-1286.

# NO_ORACLE_ANSWER for an answer a broken engine can give (CEO-1696 applied by Lon 2026-10-21 16:5x CDT, in-chat to the coo, verbatim: "I suspect you know not what you are doing and are measuring failure not
# success." · "You better fix your flawed measurement system for the test suites."; his ruling on the coo's question, "Tighten, else exclude"; ceo
# CEO-1865): a program whose expected answer a BROKEN ENGINE can produce proves nothing about SCRIP and leaves the denominator, shown in Excl, until

# it carries an answer only a real run can give. Measured by util_false_green_census.sh (harness, the coo 2026-10-21): the silent stub earned four in mode 3; errlimit and stlimit-host-option, which sbl -bf answers with no output at all, are excluded here; case-folding and indirect-real-illegal-type, which it answers with one empty line, stayed graded under the byte-exact capture of test_snoflake_suite.sh until that runner was deleted, and are excluded here since 2026-11-12 (the one grader strips the final newline of both streams, so one empty line reads as no output).

a grammar that is left-recursive (EXP, TERM and FACTOR call each other before consuming a character), which only CSNOBOL4 survives, with its heuristics turned on: sbl -bf ERROR 246 stack overflow at default, -s64m (and -s512m cannot allocate); SCRIP overflows too. Lon 2026-10-03, in-chat to hq_snobol4, verbatim: "A left recursive grammar will ever only work in old SNOBOL4 with heuristics turned on. In SPITBOL it loops infintely. So it is exluded."
